fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest LNG import/export terminal, EXISTING OR PROPOSED/APPROVED (HIFLD/EIA point layer, sourced from FERC's existing-and-proposed terminal layer; nearest within 200 km). A proposed terminal may not yet be built — confirm current status with the operator/FERC.
fields.interpretation_hints: LNG terminals signal large-scale gas export demand competing for the same supply — a siting consideration near the Gulf Coast. FERC layer; terminal locations current through 2024 approvals, operational status as of Dec 2022 — confirm current status with operator/FERC.
fields.name: nearest_lng_terminal_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No existing or proposed LNG terminal within 200 km (semantic absence), or the local HIFLD/EIA/FERC LNG-terminal gpkg was unavailable.

fields.description: US Drought Monitor category at the point (D0 Abnormally Dry .. D4 Exceptional), the MAX class of the severity-nested dissolved USDM polygons containing the point. Null = point in no drought polygon (better than D0).
fields.interpretation_hints: Water-availability / curtailment risk for evaporative and once-through data-center cooling, and a drought-stress signal for nearby hydro/thermal generation. D3/D4 flag elevated water-restriction exposure.
fields.name: drought_category
fields.null_meaning: Point falls in no USDM drought polygon (not in drought / better than D0); or the local read failed / the current-week snapshot is stale (>21 days old, a broken weekly refresh), in which case the null is failure-shaped.

fields.description: True if the queried point falls inside a designated Qualified Opportunity Zone (QOZ) census tract; False if it does not.
fields.interpretation_hints: A QOZ is a census tract designated under the 2017 Tax Cuts & Jobs Act where investors get federal capital-gains tax incentives (deferral and step-up). A real financial signal for data-center siting — capital-intensive builds in a QOZ can qualify an investment vehicle for those incentives. Membership is binary and always determinable, so False is a definitive negative, never "unknown". This is OZ 1.0 (in force through 2028); an OZ 2.0 map is expected ~2027 and will change the designated set. Designation alone is NOT a permit, entitlement, or guarantee of any tax benefit — the benefit depends on the investment structure.
fields.name: in_opportunity_zone

fields.description: The 11-character GEOID10 census-tract code of the designated Opportunity Zone containing the point (null when the point is not in any OZ).
fields.interpretation_hints: GEOID10 is the 11-char 2010-vintage census-tract FIPS code (2-digit state + 3-digit county + 6-digit tract). It is a STRING — leading zeros are significant; never parse it as an integer. Use it to join the point to tract-level demographics or to cite the specific designated tract. Null means the point is not in any designated QOZ (read in_opportunity_zone for the definitive membership boolean).
fields.name: opportunity_zone_tract_geoid
fields.null_meaning: The point does not fall inside any designated Opportunity Zone tract.

fields.description: True if the point falls in any current EPA NAAQS nonattainment area (ozone / PM2.5 / PM10 / CO / SO2 / NO2 / lead).
fields.interpretation_hints: A nonattainment designation triggers stricter New Source Review / emission-offset permitting for combustion equipment — directly raises the permitting cost and timeline for on-site gas generation and backup diesel at a data center. Maintenance and attainment areas do not set the flag.
fields.name: in_air_quality_nonattainment
fields.null_meaning: The local EPA Green Book nonattainment gpkg read failed (missing/corrupt/unsynced asset); a successful no-area result is False, not null.

fields.description: Comma-joined distinct pollutant names for which the point is in a nonattainment area (e.g. "Ozone (2015),PM2.5 (2012)").
fields.interpretation_hints: Identifies which criteria pollutants drive the permitting constraint — ozone nonattainment in particular gates NOx-emitting turbines and engines. Empty when the point is in no nonattainment area.
fields.name: air_quality_nonattainment_pollutants
fields.null_meaning: Point is in no nonattainment area, or the local Green Book gpkg read failed.

fields.description: Worst NONATTAINMENT classification across ALL classified pollutants at the point — ozone, CO, AND PM10/PM2.5, not just ozone/CO (Extreme > Severe > Serious > Moderate > Marginal). Blank for lead/SO2/NO2 (which EPA never classifies) and for maintenance-only points — this field collects classifications from NONATTAINMENT matches only, so a point whose classified areas are all Maintenance reads blank here even though those areas carry a published classification. For a single pollutant's own classification (not this cross-pollutant max), and for maintenance classifications, use air_quality_<pollutant>_classification instead (e.g. air_quality_ozone_classification, air_quality_pm25_classification).
fields.interpretation_hints: Higher classifications carry progressively stricter offset ratios and lower major-source thresholds, escalating air-permit burden for on-site generation. This field maxes across ALL of a point's classified NONATTAINMENT pollutants, so it can pair an Extreme ozone classification with an unrelated Serious PM2.5 designation — read air_quality_ozone_classification / air_quality_pm25_classification / air_quality_pm10_classification / air_quality_co_classification for a single pollutant's own number. Two blanks that are NOT "unclassified" — lead, SO2 and NO2 are never classified by EPA, and a maintenance-only point is blank here because only nonattainment matches are collected. Every current CO area nationwide is Maintenance, so a CO classification never reaches this field at all — read air_quality_co_classification for it.
fields.name: air_quality_worst_classification
fields.null_meaning: No classified pollutant (ozone/CO/PM) has a NONATTAINMENT designation at the point, or the local Green Book gpkg read failed. A maintenance-only point is also blank — read air_quality_<pollutant>_classification for those.

fields.description: Straight-line distance to the nearest EPA ACRES brownfield site within an 8 km screening band (EPA Facility Registry Service).
fields.interpretation_hints: Brownfield reuse can unlock cleanup grants and pre-disturbed, grid-adjacent land attractive for data-center siting, but also signals legacy contamination requiring due diligence. A screening proximity signal, not a contamination-exposure assessment.
fields.name: nearest_brownfield_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No ACRES brownfield within 8 km, or the local index is unavailable (bootstrap-pending / corrupt asset).

fields.description: Count of EPA ACRES brownfield sites within 8 km of the point.
fields.interpretation_hints: A density signal for legacy-industrial land availability and redevelopment activity nearby. An exact count within the 8 km band from the local EPA FRS mirror; zero means none within the band, not none in the area.
fields.name: brownfields_within_radius_count
fields.null_meaning: The local index is unavailable (bootstrap-pending / corrupt asset); a successful empty radius returns 0.

fields.description: Straight-line distance to the nearest EPA SEMS Superfund-inventory site within an 8 km screening band (EPA Facility Registry Service).
fields.interpretation_hints: SEMS is the full Superfund inventory (assessment + NPL), not NPL-listed sites only — proximity is a contamination / liability due-diligence flag, not a measure of on-site exposure. Pair with the NPL boundary layers if listed-status is needed.
fields.name: nearest_superfund_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No SEMS Superfund site within 8 km, or the local index is unavailable (bootstrap-pending / corrupt asset).

fields.description: Count of EPA SEMS Superfund-inventory sites within 8 km of the point.
fields.interpretation_hints: A density signal for legacy contamination liability nearby. An exact count within the 8 km band from the local EPA FRS mirror; zero means none within the band, not none in the area. SEMS includes assessment/archived sites, not only active NPL.
fields.name: superfund_sites_within_radius_count
fields.null_meaning: The local index is unavailable (bootstrap-pending / corrupt asset); a successful empty radius returns 0.

fields.description: Name of the California air district (CARB) whose boundary contains the point (e.g. "Bay Area", "South Coast"). Null outside California.
fields.interpretation_hints: The CA air district (CARB) is the permitting authority for stationary-source / backup-generator air permits in California — nonattainment areas (see in_air_quality_nonattainment) add NSR offset + BACT burden. Null outside California; national authority resolution is a follow-up.
fields.name: air_district_name
fields.null_meaning: The point is outside any CARB California air district (CA-only), or the local CARB air-district asset is missing/corrupt (or a containing polygon carried no usable name).

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest NOAA-charted submarine cable right-of-way corridor; 0 when the point lies inside a corridor.
fields.interpretation_hints: GROUND TRUTH (NOAA MarineCadastre, public domain). Near-shore this is landing-corridor proximity — a real subsea/international interconnection and coastal-DC signal. Large or null far inland; NOT a terrestrial long-haul-fiber measure. For terrestrial long-haul plausibility see nearest_long_haul_rail_corridor_distance_m + nearest_gas_pipeline_distance_m.
fields.name: nearest_submarine_cable_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No charted submarine cable corridor within the search radius (inland), or the query failed.

fields.description: Name of the nearest charted submarine cable system (e.g. "North Pacific Cable System"), when the corridor carries a cablesystem name.
fields.interpretation_hints: Best-effort — the charted cablesystem name of the nearest corridor; null when the nearest corridor is unnamed even though the distance is known. Names are real commercial systems (e.g. Hawaiki, TGN Pacific, Jupiter).
fields.name: nearest_submarine_cable_name
fields.null_meaning: Nearest corridor is unnamed, or no corridor within the search radius.

fields.description: Distance in meters to the nearest BTS NTAD mainline rail line (a long-haul right-of-way corridor).
fields.interpretation_hints: PROXY, not fiber ground-truth. US long-haul fiber overwhelmingly follows Class-I mainline rail rights-of-way (InterTubes, SIGCOMM 2015), so proximity to a mainline corridor is a proxy for long-haul-fiber-CAPABLE ROW — NOT confirmation of lit fiber. Near-zero is favorable for backhaul reach. Combine with nearest_gas_pipeline_distance_m + nearest_submarine_cable_distance_m; contrast with the mass-market fiber_broadband_available.
fields.name: nearest_long_haul_rail_corridor_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No mainline rail within the search radius, or the query failed.

fields.description: Operator/company of the nearest EIA interstate natural-gas pipeline (source Operator field).
fields.interpretation_hints: The company to approach for a tap on the nearest gas line. Null when the source publishes no operator for that segment.
fields.name: nearest_gas_pipeline_operator

fields.description: Type of the nearest gas pipeline — Interstate or Intrastate (source TYPEPIPE).
fields.interpretation_hints: Interstate = EIA's transmission-scale proxy (wide-diameter, high-capacity 20-42"). For the unbounded true-nearest-interstate distance use nearest_interstate_gas_pipeline_distance_m; this field types only the single nearest line within the 10 km buffer.
fields.name: nearest_gas_pipeline_type

fields.description: Count of EIA gas pipeline segments within the search radius (pipelines_radius_m).
fields.interpretation_hints: Density of nearby gas transmission. 0 = none within the buffer. Combine with nearest_gas_pipeline_type + nearest_gas_pipeline_distance_m.
fields.name: gas_pipelines_within_radius_count

fields.description: Distance in meters to the nearest EIA petroleum-product pipeline.
fields.interpretation_hints: Liquids (crude / refined products / HGL), NOT natural gas — read nearest_petroleum_pipeline_product before interpreting. Not a gas-tap signal.
fields.name: nearest_petroleum_pipeline_distance_m

fields.description: Operator of the nearest petroleum-product pipeline.
fields.interpretation_hints: Null when the source publishes no operator for that segment.
fields.name: nearest_petroleum_pipeline_operator

fields.description: Commodity carried by the nearest petroleum-product pipeline (e.g. crude oil, refined products, HGL/NGL).
fields.interpretation_hints: The product classification for the nearest liquids line; distinguishes crude vs refined vs HGL. Not natural gas.
fields.name: nearest_petroleum_pipeline_product

fields.description: Count of petroleum-product pipeline segments within pipelines_radius_m.
fields.interpretation_hints: Density of nearby liquids pipelines. 0 = none within the buffer.
fields.name: petroleum_pipelines_within_radius_count

fields.description: Search radius in meters used for the gas + petroleum pipeline proximity counts.
fields.interpretation_hints: The buffer distance behind gas_pipelines_within_radius_count and petroleum_pipelines_within_radius_count. A count of 0 means "none within this radius", not "no pipelines exist".
fields.name: pipelines_radius_m

fields.description: Unbounded geodesic distance in meters to the nearest EIA INTERSTATE natural-gas transmission trunkline (TYPEPIPE = Interstate).
fields.interpretation_hints: The headline BTM-gas transmission-access signal. Unbounded (searches ~100 km) so rural parcels the 10 km nearest_gas_pipeline_distance_m buffer nulls on still get a real distance. Interstate is EIA's transmission-scale proxy (wide-diameter, high-capacity 20-42") — contrast with the 10 km nearest_gas_pipeline_distance_m. Diameter, line pressure, firm transport capacity and tap lead time are pipeline-OPERATOR confirmations, NOT geospatial facts (see gas_tap_feasibility_note); never infer them from this distance.
fields.name: nearest_interstate_gas_pipeline_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No interstate gas pipeline within the search radius, or the query failed.

fields.description: Operator/company of the nearest EIA interstate natural-gas transmission trunkline (source Operator field).
fields.interpretation_hints: The pipeline operator to approach for a tap on the nearest interstate line. Null when no interstate line is within the search radius.
fields.name: nearest_interstate_gas_pipeline_operator
fields.null_meaning: No interstate gas pipeline within the search radius, or the query failed.

fields.description: Unbounded geodesic distance in meters to the nearest EIA gas TRANSMISSION pipeline of ANY type (interstate or intrastate).
fields.interpretation_hints: The any-transmission companion to the interstate-only field (mirrors rail's nearest-any vs mainline pair). Use this for "is any transmission gas line reachable"; use nearest_interstate_gas_pipeline_distance_m for the transmission-scale (interstate) signal. Not the 10 km buffer nearest_gas_pipeline_distance_m.
fields.name: nearest_gas_transmission_pipeline_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No gas transmission pipeline within the search radius, or the query failed.

fields.description: Grid electricity price expressed per MWh — the EIA state industrial retail price (USD/kWh) x 1000. All-in retail (includes delivery, capital recovery, O&M). Derived; MEDIUM confidence (deterministic unit conversion).
fields.interpretation_hints: The symmetric baseline for the behind-the-meter gas screen. Compare with modeled_onsite_gas_generation_cost_usd_per_mwh, but note the comparison is ASYMMETRIC — grid is all-in retail, modeled gas is fuel-only — so grid_price > modeled_gas means 'worth deeper study,' NOT 'build gas.'
fields.name: grid_price_usd_per_mwh
fields.null_meaning: Point did not resolve to a U.S. state with a published industrial retail electricity price in the local EIA table (the input price is served locally; no API key).

derivation.formula: natural_gas_industrial_price_usd_per_mcf / 1.037 MMBtu/Mcf x 9.5 MMBtu/MWh simple-cycle genset heat rate (fuel-only USD/MWh)

fields.description: MODELED fuel-only cost of on-site natural-gas generation — the EIA state industrial gas price (USD/Mcf) / 1.037 MMBtu/Mcf x 9.5 MMBtu/MWh simple-cycle genset heat rate. NOT a delivered-power quote. Derived; LOW confidence (heat-rate assumption dominates).
fields.interpretation_hints: Fuel-only screen. Excludes capital recovery, O&M, emissions, gas delivery/demand charges. An efficient combined-cycle (~6.4 MMBtu/MWh) would be ~33% lower. Actual economics require operator confirmation of pipeline pressure, firm transport, lead time, and permit timelines.
fields.name: modeled_onsite_gas_generation_cost_usd_per_mwh
fields.null_meaning: Point did not resolve to a U.S. state with a published industrial natural-gas price in the local EIA table (the input price is served locally; no API key).

fields.description: Count of EIA Atlas electric substations (>=69 kV layer) within substations_radius_m (10 km) of the point.
fields.interpretation_hints: Substation-density proxy — more mapped substations nearby means more potential interconnection injection points (EIA Atlas / HIFLD map topology, partly imagery-derived). A count, NOT a capacity or deliverability claim; true redundancy is a utility load-study question. Zero is a concrete answer (no mapped substation in range), never a failure. Search radius is substations_radius_m.
fields.name: substations_within_radius_count
fields.null_meaning: A count of 0 is a concrete answer (no mapped substation in range), not null; a null means the local substation index is unavailable (bootstrap-pending).

fields.description: Search radius (meters) used for substations_within_radius_count — the fixed 10 km band.
fields.interpretation_hints: The constant 10 km search radius behind substations_within_radius_count; it does not vary by point. Exposed so the count is self-describing.
fields.name: substations_radius_m
fields.null_meaning: The local substation index is unavailable (bootstrap-pending).

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest EPA mandatory Class I federal area (national park / wilderness > 6000 acres); 0 when the point lies inside one.
fields.interpretation_hints: A BTM gas plant clearing PSD major-source thresholds near a Class I area triggers mandatory Federal-Land-Manager consultation + visibility / air-quality-related-values modeling (customary screening ~300 km) — a lead-time and cost escalator distinct from nonattainment NNSR. Large or null far from any Class I area.
fields.name: nearest_class_i_area_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No Class I federal area within the search radius, the asset is not yet bootstrapped, or the query failed.

fields.description: Name of the nearest Class I federal area (e.g. "Yosemite NP", "Sequoia NP").
fields.interpretation_hints: The specific national park / wilderness whose Federal Land Manager would be consulted in PSD permitting. Null when no area is within the search radius.
fields.name: nearest_class_i_area_name
fields.null_meaning: No Class I federal area within the search radius, or the query failed.

fields.description: Managing federal agency of the nearest Class I area (USDI-NPS / USDA-FS / USDI-FWS / BIA).
fields.interpretation_hints: Identifies which Federal Land Manager (National Park Service, Forest Service, Fish & Wildlife Service, or Bureau of Indian Affairs) governs the consultation. Null when no area is within the search radius.
fields.name: nearest_class_i_area_agency
fields.null_meaning: No Class I federal area within the search radius, or the query failed.

fields.description: True if the point falls in any current EPA NAAQS maintenance area (a former nonattainment area redesignated to attainment, still under an approved maintenance plan).
fields.interpretation_hints: Maintenance areas carry anti-backsliding New Source Review obligations under the approved maintenance plan — a material permit-path signal for on-site gas generation even though the area is not currently nonattainment. Nonattainment and attainment areas do not set this flag.
fields.name: in_air_quality_maintenance
fields.null_meaning: The local EPA Green Book maintenance gpkg read failed (missing/corrupt/unsynced asset); a successful no-area result is False, not null.

fields.description: Comma-joined distinct pollutant names for which the point is in a maintenance area (e.g. "Ozone (2008),CO").
fields.interpretation_hints: Identifies which criteria pollutants carry anti-backsliding maintenance-plan constraints at the point. Empty when the point is in no maintenance area.
fields.name: air_quality_maintenance_pollutants
fields.null_meaning: Point is in no maintenance area, or the local Green Book gpkg read failed.

fields.description: Active-queue nameplate MW in the containing county attributed to the PJM interconnection queue (LBNL 'Queued Up' project-level region attribution).
fields.interpretation_hints: Per-ISO slice of the county queue total. Null with an absence marker means no active project applied to PJM from this county — absence, not zero. ~5.5% of queue counties straddle two regions, so slices can coexist. County aggregate, annual snapshot.
fields.name: interconnection_queue_active_capacity_pjm_mw
fields.null_meaning: No active PJM-queue project in this county, or dataset not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Active-queue nameplate MW in the containing county attributed to the MISO interconnection queue (LBNL 'Queued Up' project-level region attribution).
fields.interpretation_hints: Per-ISO slice of the county queue total. Null with an absence marker means no active project applied to MISO from this county — absence, not zero. County aggregate, annual snapshot.
fields.name: interconnection_queue_active_capacity_miso_mw
fields.null_meaning: No active MISO-queue project in this county, or dataset not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Active-queue nameplate MW in the containing county attributed to the ERCOT interconnection queue (LBNL 'Queued Up' project-level region attribution).
fields.interpretation_hints: Per-ISO slice of the county queue total. Null with an absence marker means no active project applied to ERCOT from this county — absence, not zero. County aggregate, annual snapshot.
fields.name: interconnection_queue_active_capacity_ercot_mw
fields.null_meaning: No active ERCOT-queue project in this county, or dataset not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Active-queue nameplate MW in the containing county attributed to the CAISO interconnection queue (LBNL 'Queued Up' project-level region attribution).
fields.interpretation_hints: Per-ISO slice of the county queue total. Null with an absence marker means no active project applied to CAISO from this county — absence, not zero. CAISO/West straddle counties (the AZ/NV/CA seam) carry BOTH slices. County aggregate, annual snapshot.
fields.name: interconnection_queue_active_capacity_caiso_mw
fields.null_meaning: No active CAISO-queue project in this county, or dataset not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Active-queue nameplate MW in the containing county attributed to the SPP interconnection queue (LBNL 'Queued Up' project-level region attribution).
fields.interpretation_hints: Per-ISO slice of the county queue total. Null with an absence marker means no active project applied to SPP from this county — absence, not zero. County aggregate, annual snapshot.
fields.name: interconnection_queue_active_capacity_spp_mw
fields.null_meaning: No active SPP-queue project in this county, or dataset not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Active-queue nameplate MW in the containing county attributed to the NYISO interconnection queue (LBNL 'Queued Up' project-level region attribution).
fields.interpretation_hints: Per-ISO slice of the county queue total. Null with an absence marker means no active project applied to NYISO from this county — absence, not zero. County aggregate, annual snapshot.
fields.name: interconnection_queue_active_capacity_nyiso_mw
fields.null_meaning: No active NYISO-queue project in this county, or dataset not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Active-queue nameplate MW in the containing county attributed to the ISO-NE interconnection queue (LBNL 'Queued Up' project-level region attribution).
fields.interpretation_hints: Per-ISO slice of the county queue total. Null with an absence marker means no active project applied to ISO-NE from this county — absence, not zero. County aggregate, annual snapshot.
fields.name: interconnection_queue_active_capacity_isone_mw
fields.null_meaning: No active ISO-NE-queue project in this county, or dataset not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Active-queue nameplate MW in the containing county attributed to LBNL's non-ISO 'West' bucket — projects interconnecting through non-CAISO Western utilities (BPA, PacifiCorp, APS, WAPA...), NOT an organized ISO/RTO market.
fields.interpretation_hints: Non-ISO catch-all slice of the county queue total (the Western Interconnection outside CAISO). Null with an absence marker means no active project in this bucket from this county — absence, not zero. CAISO/West straddle counties (the AZ/NV/CA seam) carry BOTH slices. County aggregate, annual snapshot.
fields.name: interconnection_queue_active_capacity_west_mw
fields.null_meaning: No active non-CAISO-West queue project in this county, or dataset not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Active-queue nameplate MW in the containing county attributed to LBNL's non-ISO 'Southeast' bucket — projects interconnecting through Southeastern utilities (Duke, Southern Company, TVA, FPL...), NOT an organized ISO/RTO market.
fields.interpretation_hints: Non-ISO catch-all slice of the county queue total (SERC-area vertically-integrated utilities). Null with an absence marker means no active project in this bucket from this county — absence, not zero. County aggregate, annual snapshot.
fields.name: interconnection_queue_active_capacity_southeast_mw
fields.null_meaning: No active Southeast-utility queue project in this county, or dataset not bootstrapped.

fields.description: ISO/RTO electricity market whose territory footprint contains the point (PJM, MISO, ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, or ISO-NE), from the HIFLD/ORNL Independent System Operators polygons (2019-era delineation, point-in-polygon).
fields.interpretation_hints: Which organized wholesale market governs interconnection and energy pricing at this point. Null with an absence marker = non-RTO territory (Southeast or non-CAISO West utilities, non-ISO pockets like LADWP or SMUD, or outside CONUS) — absence, not error. Seams are approximate at the 2019 delineation (notably SPP/ERCOT in the Permian; SPP's 2026 western expansion not reflected); in seam-overlap zones the smallest containing footprint is reported and the others are noted. Correlates with the per-ISO interconnection-queue MW fields, which share the same market vocabulary.
fields.name: iso_rto
fields.null_meaning: Point is outside every ISO/RTO footprint (non-RTO territory), or dataset not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest open hospital (Overture places, conflated Meta/Microsoft/Foursquare POI data; confidence >= 0.5, US only).
fields.interpretation_hints: Emergency-services proximity signal for siting and insurability; excludes veterinary/animal hospitals via the Overture taxonomy.
fields.name: nearest_hospital_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No open hospital with Overture confidence >= 0.5 within 50 km of the point.

fields.description: Name of the nearest open hospital (Overture places).
fields.interpretation_hints: Secondary to the distance field; POI names in conflated data can lag renames/closures — provenance notes carry the record's own Overture conflation confidence.
fields.name: nearest_hospital_name
fields.null_meaning: No open hospital within 50 km, or the nearest record has no primary name.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest open fire station (Overture places; confidence >= 0.5, US only).
fields.interpretation_hints: Fire-response proximity drives insurability and industrial permitting context; taxonomy-normalized (fire_department folds in; private fire-protection services excluded).
fields.name: nearest_fire_station_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No open fire station with Overture confidence >= 0.5 within 50 km of the point.

fields.description: Name of the nearest open fire station (Overture places).
fields.interpretation_hints: Secondary to the distance field; provenance notes carry the record's Overture conflation confidence.
fields.name: nearest_fire_station_name
fields.null_meaning: No open fire station within 50 km, or the nearest record has no primary name.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest open school, preschool through K-12 (Overture places; confidence >= 0.5, US only).
fields.interpretation_hints: Sensitive-receptor proximity for permitting and community-opposition risk; taxonomy-scoped to real schools (driving/dance/cosmetology schools excluded).
fields.name: nearest_school_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No open school with Overture confidence >= 0.5 within 50 km of the point.

fields.description: Name of the nearest open school (Overture places).
fields.interpretation_hints: Secondary to the distance field; provenance notes carry the record's Overture conflation confidence.
fields.name: nearest_school_name
fields.null_meaning: No open school within 50 km, or the nearest record has no primary name.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest open grocery store or supermarket (Overture places; confidence >= 0.5, US only).
fields.interpretation_hints: Everyday-amenity access proxy for workforce logistics and residential-context screening; supermarkets fold into grocery_store via the Overture taxonomy.
fields.name: nearest_grocery_store_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No open grocery store with Overture confidence >= 0.5 within 50 km of the point.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest open lodging (hotel/motel/resort/hostel; Overture places; confidence >= 0.5, US only).
fields.interpretation_hints: Construction-crew and visiting-staff logistics signal for remote-site development.
fields.name: nearest_lodging_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No open lodging with Overture confidence >= 0.5 within 50 km of the point.

fields.description: Count of Overture places (points of interest / amenities) within 1 km of the point — restaurants, cafes, bars, shops, gas stations, pharmacies, banks, schools, and every other POI category (confidence >= 0.5, permanently-closed records excluded, US only).
fields.interpretation_hints: Built-up/commercial-context density proxy for "points of interest" / "amenities" / POIs — near zero in greenfield and remote land, thousands in urban cores. Counts ALL categories (restaurant, cafe, bar, gym, pharmacy, retail, office, …), not just the per-concept nearest fields. Robust to individual stale POIs by construction.
fields.name: poi_count_1km
fields.null_meaning: The Overture places query failed; the count is otherwise always present (0 is a valid value).

fields.description: Overture road class of the nearest major road (motorway / trunk / primary / secondary).
fields.interpretation_hints: motorway = controlled-access highway, trunk = major arterial, primary/secondary = principal surface routes. Discriminates highway access quality for heavy-equipment logistics.
fields.name: nearest_major_road_class
fields.null_meaning: No Overture major road was found within the fallback search radius.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest vehicular Overture road of any class within the 500 m query radius (pedestrian/cycle classes excluded).
fields.interpretation_hints: Any-class counterpart of nearest_major_road_distance_m — includes residential, service, and unclassified roads, so it measures basic vehicular site access rather than highway access. Footways, paths, steps, cycleways, and pedestrian streets are excluded.
fields.name: nearest_road_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No Overture road of any class was found within the 500 m query radius.

fields.description: Primary name of the nearest vehicular Overture road of any class.
fields.name: nearest_road_name
fields.null_meaning: No Overture road was found within the 500 m query radius, or the nearest road has no primary name tagged.

fields.description: Overture road class of the nearest vehicular road (motorway / trunk / primary / secondary / tertiary / residential / service / unclassified / ...; pedestrian/cycle classes are excluded from the search).
fields.name: nearest_road_class
fields.null_meaning: No Overture road was found within the 500 m query radius, or the nearest road carries no class label.

fields.description: Surface of the nearest vehicular Overture road (paved / unpaved / gravel / dirt / ...), from the first road_surface rule on the segment.
fields.interpretation_hints: Overture road_surface is sparsely tagged outside major roads; an untagged segment defaults by class (motorway..residential are paved in practice). Null means untagged, not unpaved.
fields.name: nearest_road_surface
fields.null_meaning: No Overture road was found within the 500 m query radius, or the nearest road has no road_surface rule tagged (untagged does NOT imply unpaved).

fields.description: Count of vehicular Overture road segments within 500 m of the point (pedestrian/cycle classes excluded).
fields.interpretation_hints: Site-access / built-up density proxy — 0 in remote greenfield, tens to hundreds in urban cores. Counts segments (a long road can contribute several), so compare relatively, not as an absolute road count.
fields.name: roads_within_500m_count
fields.null_meaning: The Overture roads query failed; the count is otherwise always present (0 is a valid value).

fields.description: Summed centerline length in meters of vehicular Overture road segments clipped to a 500 m radius disc around the point (pedestrian/cycle classes excluded).
fields.interpretation_hints: Density companion to roads_within_500m_count that is robust to segmentation (many short segments vs one long road measure the same). Zero in roadless greenfield.
fields.name: total_road_length_within_500m_m
fields.null_meaning: The Overture roads query failed; the length is otherwise always present (0.0 is a valid value).

fields.description: Monitoring-location id (e.g. USGS-08075900) of the nearest USGS gage that reported a daily-mean discharge within the last 7 days, within ~10 km.
fields.interpretation_hints: The id resolves on waterdata.usgs.gov for period-of-record hydrographs; pair with nearest_usgs_gage_daily_discharge_cfs for the flow value.
fields.name: nearest_usgs_gage_id
fields.null_meaning: No USGS gage reporting daily-mean discharge within the last 7 days inside the ~10 km search radius, or the NWIS OGC fetch failed.

fields.description: Station name of the nearest actively-reporting USGS discharge gage (from the monitoring-locations collection).
fields.interpretation_hints: USGS station names encode the stream and locality (e.g. "Buffalo Bayou at Houston, TX") — useful to identify WHICH watercourse the discharge reading describes.
fields.name: nearest_usgs_gage_name
fields.null_meaning: No actively-reporting gage in range, the gage record carries no name, or the name lookup failed.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest USGS gage that reported a daily-mean discharge within the last 7 days.
fields.interpretation_hints: Distance is to the gage, not to the stream itself — a gage measures the reach it sits on, so treat the reading as reach-level context.
fields.name: nearest_usgs_gage_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No USGS gage reporting daily-mean discharge within the last 7 days inside the ~10 km search radius, or the NWIS OGC fetch failed.

fields.description: Latest daily-mean streamflow (discharge, USGS parameter 00060) at the nearest actively-reporting USGS gage. The reading date is disclosed in the field notes; daily values lag ~1 day.
fields.interpretation_hints: A live surface-water availability signal — sustained flow supports industrial/cooling intake, irrigation, and municipal supply; compare against surface_water_supply_use_index_huc12 for basin-level stress context. Reach-level (measured at the gage, ~up to 10 km away), not parcel-level.
fields.name: nearest_usgs_gage_daily_discharge_cfs
fields.null_meaning: No USGS gage reporting daily-mean discharge within the last 7 days inside the ~10 km search radius, or the NWIS OGC fetch failed.

fields.description: FEMA NFHL flood-zone code at the queried point (e.g. AE, VE, X, A, AO), from the SFHA-driving polygon where multiple intersect.
fields.interpretation_hints: FEMA's authoritative zone designation. A* / V* = Special Flood Hazard Area (1% annual chance); V/VE = coastal high-hazard (wave) zone; X = outside the SFHA. NFHL horizontal control is ~1:12,000 / ±38 ft — not a Standard Flood Hazard Determination Form. Pair with coastal_high_hazard and fema_base_flood_elevation.
fields.name: fema_flood_zone
fields.null_meaning: NFHL covers the point but no flood-zone polygon intersects, or NFHL does not cover the coordinate, or the intersecting polygon has a blank FLD_ZONE.

fields.description: FEMA NFHL zone subtype (ZONE_SUBTY) at the point, e.g. FLOODWAY, "0.2 PCT ANNUAL CHANCE FLOOD HAZARD", or a coastal-A / LiMWA descriptor.
fields.interpretation_hints: Refines the zone. "0.2 PCT ANNUAL CHANCE" = shaded Zone X (500-yr, not SFHA); FLOODWAY = regulatory floodway; coastal-A / LiMWA marks moderate (1.5-3 ft) wave action landward of the V zone (coastal_high_hazard is False there).
fields.name: flood_zone_subtype
fields.null_meaning: No subtype on the intersecting polygon, or no polygon / coverage.

fields.description: True if the FEMA flood zone is V-family (V/VE/V1-30) — a coastal high-hazard area subject to high-velocity wave action (breaking waves >= 3 ft).
fields.interpretation_hints: The single most decision-relevant coastal-flood distinction. True = wave-action high-hazard (V/VE); coastal-A / LiMWA (moderate wave) is False here but visible in flood_zone_subtype. A screen — request an Elevation Certificate / LOMA for regulatory use.
fields.name: coastal_high_hazard
fields.null_meaning: No flood-zone polygon at the point, NFHL coverage absent, or an intersecting polygon whose FLD_ZONE is blank (zone unresolved).

fields.description: FEMA Base Flood Elevation (STATIC_BFE) at the point, NAVD88, when the intersecting polygon carries one on a NAVD88 datum.
fields.interpretation_hints: NAVD88, whole-foot rounded, populated mainly in coastal/lake and fixed-BFE AE polygons; null in Zone A and variable riverine AE (BFE lives in a separate line layer there). Under NFIP Risk Rating 2.0 BFE is no longer a direct rating variable — a regulatory design/elevation threshold and surge-exposure input, not an insurance rate.
fields.name: fema_base_flood_elevation
fields.null_meaning: No NAVD88 BFE on the intersecting polygon (Zone A / variable AE / non-NAVD88 datum), or no polygon / coverage.

fields.description: Fraction (0.0-1.0) of the matched Regrid parcel's own boundary covered by USFWS NWI wetland polygons — the parcel share, computed by intersecting NWI wetlands with the parcel boundary in the parcel's local UTM (equal-area) projection. NOT the whole mapped wetland polygon's size (see the terrain-layer wetland_acres for that).
fields.interpretation_hints: Same NWI fence as intersects_wetland — a biological inventory, not a §404/jurisdictional determination; do NOT state 'USACE-jurisdictional' or 'permit required' from this alone. This is the PARCEL SHARE (NWI wetland ∩ Regrid parcel boundary), distinct from wetland_acres (terrain), which reports the whole selected polygon regardless of parcel. 0.0 is a real 'no overlap on this parcel' answer, distinct from null (no Regrid parcel matched at this coordinate, or its boundary geometry was unusable). On a small parcel, a small nonzero fraction can sit near the source's mapping resolution — treat it as directional, not survey-grade, and corroborate with a delineation before it is load-bearing for a permitting or acreage decision.
fields.name: wetland_fraction_of_parcel
fields.null_meaning: No Regrid parcel at this coordinate.

fields.description: Absolute acres of USFWS NWI wetland polygon area intersecting the matched Regrid parcel's own boundary — the parcel-clipped wetland acreage, computed in the parcel's local UTM (equal-area) projection. NOT the whole mapped wetland polygon's size (see the terrain-layer wetland_acres for that).
fields.interpretation_hints: Same NWI fence as intersects_wetland — a biological inventory, not a §404/jurisdictional determination; do NOT state 'USACE-jurisdictional' or 'permit required' from this alone. This is the PARCEL SHARE (NWI wetland ∩ Regrid parcel boundary), distinct from wetland_acres (terrain), which reports the whole selected polygon regardless of parcel — a large polygon can report many acres there while only a sliver falls on this parcel. 0.0 is a real 'no overlap on this parcel' answer, distinct from null (no Regrid parcel matched at this coordinate, or its boundary geometry was unusable). On a small parcel, a small nonzero value can sit near the source's mapping resolution — treat it as directional, not survey-grade, and corroborate with a delineation before it is load-bearing for a permitting or acreage decision.
fields.name: wetland_acres_on_parcel
fields.null_meaning: No Regrid parcel at this coordinate.

fields.description: Annual diffuse horizontal irradiance sum (kWh/m2/day) from one NREL NSRDB GOES-TMY year — the portion of GHI arriving as diffuse (non-beam) sky light.
fields.interpretation_hints: Feeds diffuse_fraction_annual; high DHI relative to GHI (cloudy/humid climates) favors fixed-tilt + bifacial PV, low DHI (arid/clear climates) favors single-axis tracking.
fields.name: dhi_annual_kwh_m2_day
fields.null_meaning: No NREL key or NSRDB contact email, NSRDB GOES-TMY fetch failed/timed out, or outside coverage.

fields.description: Annual diffuse fraction (ΣDHI/ΣGHI, 0-1) from one NREL NSRDB GOES-TMY year — the share of global irradiance arriving as diffuse (non-beam) light.
fields.interpretation_hints: High (~0.3+ cloudy/humid East) favors fixed-tilt + bifacial and erodes single-axis-tracker gain; low (~0.15 arid SW) favors trackers/CSP.
fields.name: diffuse_fraction_annual
fields.null_meaning: No NREL key or NSRDB contact email, NSRDB GOES-TMY fetch failed/timed out, or outside coverage.

fields.description: Annual clear-sky (cloud-free-modeled) global horizontal irradiance sum (kWh/m2/day) from one NREL NSRDB GOES-TMY year — the theoretical maximum GHI absent clouds and aerosols.
fields.interpretation_hints: The ceiling clear_sky_ratio_ghi_annual measures against; useful alongside all-sky GHI to gauge how much cloud cover erodes the theoretical resource.
fields.name: clearsky_ghi_annual_kwh_m2_day
fields.null_meaning: No NREL key or NSRDB contact email, NSRDB GOES-TMY fetch failed/timed out, or outside coverage.

fields.description: Annual clear-sky direct normal irradiance sum (kWh/m2/day) from one NREL NSRDB GOES-TMY year — the theoretical maximum beam irradiance absent clouds and aerosols.
fields.interpretation_hints: The ceiling dni_clear_sky_ratio_annual measures against; CSP/tracking economics depend on how closely all-sky DNI tracks this ceiling.
fields.name: clearsky_dni_annual_kwh_m2_day
fields.null_meaning: No NREL key or NSRDB contact email, NSRDB GOES-TMY fetch failed/timed out, or outside coverage.

fields.description: Annual clear-sky ratio for GHI (ΣGHI/ΣClearsky GHI, 0-1) from one NREL NSRDB GOES-TMY year — the fraction of the theoretical clear-sky global irradiance actually realized once clouds and aerosols are accounted for.
fields.interpretation_hints: High (~0.7+) signals a consistently sunny climate with low cloud loss; low (~0.5 or below) means persistent cloud cover materially erodes yield versus the clear-sky ceiling.
fields.name: clear_sky_ratio_ghi_annual
fields.null_meaning: No NREL key or NSRDB contact email, NSRDB GOES-TMY fetch failed/timed out, or outside coverage.

fields.description: Annual clear-sky ratio for DNI (ΣDNI/ΣClearsky DNI, 0-1) from one NREL NSRDB GOES-TMY year — the fraction of the theoretical clear-sky beam irradiance actually realized.
fields.interpretation_hints: A low ratio despite decent GHI signals hazy or aerosol-laden skies that scatter beam light, eroding CSP/single-axis-tracker upside even where GHI looks fine.
fields.name: dni_clear_sky_ratio_annual
fields.null_meaning: No NREL key or NSRDB contact email, NSRDB GOES-TMY fetch failed/timed out, or outside coverage.

fields.description: Annual mean aerosol optical depth (dimensionless, MERRA-2-derived) from one NREL NSRDB GOES-TMY year — atmospheric aerosol loading (haze, smoke, dust) that scatters and absorbs irradiance.
fields.interpretation_hints: High AOD depresses DNI more than GHI, eroding CSP/tracker economics even where headline GHI looks strong. MERRA-2 reanalysis ~50 km, downscaled — regional, not site-specific.
fields.name: aerosol_optical_depth_annual_mean
fields.null_meaning: No NREL key or NSRDB contact email, NSRDB GOES-TMY fetch failed/timed out, or outside coverage. MERRA-2 reanalysis ~50 km, downscaled — regional, not site-specific.

fields.description: Annual mean total-column precipitable water (cm, MERRA-2-derived) from one NREL NSRDB GOES-TMY year — atmospheric water vapor that attenuates irradiance.
fields.interpretation_hints: High precipitable water (humid climates) modestly depresses DNI via vapor absorption and scattering. MERRA-2 reanalysis ~50 km, downscaled — regional, not site-specific.
fields.name: precipitable_water_annual_mean_cm
fields.null_meaning: No NREL key or NSRDB contact email, NSRDB GOES-TMY fetch failed/timed out, or outside coverage. MERRA-2 reanalysis ~50 km, downscaled — regional, not site-specific.

fields.description: Annual mean near-surface (10 m) wind speed (m/s, MERRA-2-derived) from one NREL NSRDB GOES-TMY year — used to estimate PV module cooling and thermal derate.
fields.interpretation_hints: Higher wind speed improves PV module cooling and modestly reduces thermal derate, a small yield gain. MERRA-2 reanalysis ~50 km, downscaled — regional, not site-specific.
fields.name: near_surface_wind_speed_annual_mean_ms
fields.null_meaning: No NREL key or NSRDB contact email, NSRDB GOES-TMY fetch failed/timed out, or outside coverage. MERRA-2 reanalysis ~50 km, downscaled — regional, not site-specific.

fields.description: Annual plane-of-array irradiance — the sum of the 12 monthly PVWatts poa_monthly values (each already kWh/m2 for that month) — at the advertised optimal fixed tilt (|lat|), open-rack. From the SAME NREL PVWatts v8 call that yields capacity factor / specific yield.
fields.interpretation_hints: The in-plane resource at optimal fixed tilt; the yield denominator. Modeled transposition (POA from GHI/DNI/DHI) carries roughly +/-5-8% model uncertainty; TMY typical-year weather, not a measured year.
fields.name: poa_irradiance_optimal_tilt_kwh_m2_yr
fields.null_meaning: NREL key not configured, PVWatts fetch failed, or the PVWatts response lacked a complete 12-month poa_monthly array.

fields.description: Worst-case ponding frequency class (None / Rare / Occasional / Frequent / Very frequent) of the dominant SSURGO component, aggregated across its 12 monthly comonth records via Soil Data Access.
fields.interpretation_hints: Ponding indicates standing water from a perched water table or poor internal drainage rather than overbank flooding — a driver of slab/foundation saturation, corrosion, and equipment-pad drainage design for DC, solar, and battery sites. 'None' is a real reported value (the component does not pond), not missing data; SSURGO is reconnaissance-scale and dominant-component-only, not a site-specific ponding survey.
fields.name: soil_ponding_frequency_class
fields.null_meaning: Outside the CONUS gNATSGO grid, falls back to live USDA SDA (preserves AK/HI/PR coverage); genuinely unsurveyed (ocean / no live SDA survey) → whole soil block null; or the dominant component has no ponding records for any month.

fields.description: USDA SSURGO hydrologic soil group of the dominant component (A/B/C/D and dual A/D, B/D, C/D; first letter = artificially-drained condition, second = natural undrained state).
fields.interpretation_hints: Runoff/infiltration class for NRCS curve-number sizing on large impervious data-center/solar pads; combine with slope_degrees. A modeling input, not a stormwater-permit determination or measured infiltration rate, and invalid after grading (compaction pushes a site toward D). Dominant-component, reconnaissance-scale.
fields.name: soil_hydrologic_group
fields.null_meaning: Outside the CONUS gNATSGO grid, falls back to live USDA SDA (preserves AK/HI/PR coverage); genuinely unsurveyed (ocean / no live SDA survey) → whole soil block null; or hydgrp not populated for the dominant component.

fields.description: Representative depth (cm) to the top of the shallowest root/water-restrictive layer in the dominant SSURGO component (0-200 cm; 200 or null = no restriction found within the described 200 cm profile, right-censored — not a measured 2 m depth).
fields.interpretation_hints: Depth (cm) to the shallowest root/water restriction; 200 or null = no restriction within the described 200 cm profile (right-censored), not a measured 2 m depth. Pair with soil_restrictive_layer_kind. Not a boring log or geotechnical bedrock depth for foundations.
fields.name: soil_restrictive_layer_depth_cm
fields.null_meaning: Outside the CONUS gNATSGO grid, falls back to live USDA SDA (preserves AK/HI/PR coverage); genuinely unsurveyed (ocean / no live SDA survey) → whole soil block null; or resdept_r not populated for the dominant component.

fields.description: Type of the shallowest root/water-restrictive layer in the dominant SSURGO component (e.g. Lithic bedrock, Paralithic bedrock, Densic material, Duripan, Fragipan).
fields.interpretation_hints: Type of the restriction at soil_restrictive_layer_depth_cm (Lithic bedrock hardest → Paralithic/Densic/Duripan/Fragipan pans). A pedological restriction to roots/water — not a geotechnical rock-quality, rippability, or bearing classification.
fields.name: soil_restrictive_layer_kind
fields.null_meaning: Outside the CONUS gNATSGO grid, falls back to live USDA SDA (preserves AK/HI/PR coverage); genuinely unsurveyed (ocean / no live SDA survey) → whole soil block null; or reskind not populated for the dominant component.

fields.description: Plant-available water capacity of the dominant SSURGO component as a volume fraction (cm water per cm soil, ~0.01-0.30) between field capacity and wilting point — a ratio, not a total-water depth.
fields.interpretation_hints: Plant-available water as a volume fraction (cm/cm, ~0.01-0.30), not a depth — multiply by rooting depth for total storage. Screens revegetation/ground-cover establishment on solar sites. Dominant-component representative value.
fields.name: soil_available_water_capacity
fields.null_meaning: Outside the CONUS gNATSGO grid, falls back to live USDA SDA (preserves AK/HI/PR coverage); genuinely unsurveyed (ocean / no live SDA survey) → whole soil block null; or awc_r not populated for the dominant component.

fields.description: USLE/RUSLE whole-soil erodibility factor (Kw) of the dominant SSURGO component — a dimensionless index (~0.02-0.69, higher = more erodible).
fields.interpretation_hints: USLE/RUSLE whole-soil erodibility index (~0.02-0.69, higher = more erodible) for SWPPP/erosion-control screening with slope_degrees. One input factor — not a site erosion rate or sediment yield.
fields.name: soil_erodibility_k_factor
fields.null_meaning: Outside the CONUS gNATSGO grid, falls back to live USDA SDA (preserves AK/HI/PR coverage); genuinely unsurveyed (ocean / no live SDA survey) → whole soil block null; or kwfact not populated for the dominant component.

fields.description: Operating utility of the nearest EIA power plant (EIA-860 Utility_Na, the company 'responsible for day-to-day operations').
fields.interpretation_hints: The plant OPERATOR — NOT the owner (a separate EIA schedule this layer omits; often a different IPP/LLC) and NOT the utility that would serve your site's retail or interconnection load (see service_territory_holder; the real answer is a load study). A nearby merchant/IPP operator can be an interconnection/co-development lead — but read nearest_power_plant_sector first, because a commercial/industrial-sector operator is usually the host business (a bank, a hospital, a university), not a generator you can transact with, so an operator name alone is not a lead. The nearest plant may be a behind-the-meter genset — combine with nearest_power_plant_capacity_mw and nearest_power_plant_technology to judge if it's real grid generation. EIA-860M, plants >=1 MW.
fields.name: nearest_power_plant_operator
fields.null_meaning: No EIA plant within the plants search radius, or the operating-utility attribute is blank for the nearest plant.

fields.description: Generation technology (prime mover + fuel) of the nearest EIA power plant (EIA-860 tech_desc).
fields.interpretation_hints: More specific than nearest_power_plant_primary_fuel (baseload Combined Cycle vs peaker Combustion Turbine vs backup engine vs Batteries/Solar/Wind). May list multiple generator technologies for a multi-unit plant (semicolon-joined, plant-level roster — NOT the single nearest unit). Implies no capacity or availability; the nearest plant may be behind-the-meter. Pair with nearest_power_plant_capacity_mw to discount tiny backup gensets, and with nearest_power_plant_sector, which is EIA's own published classification of whether the operator's primary business is selling electricity. Prime mover alone does NOT identify a backup engine — 787 US plants are 'Petroleum Liquids' and most petroleum plants are Electric Utility village diesel or black-start units, i.e. genuine grid generation. EIA-860M, plants >=1 MW.
fields.name: nearest_power_plant_technology
fields.null_meaning: No EIA plant within the plants search radius, or the technology attribute is blank for the nearest plant.

fields.description: Gross nameplate capacity (MW) of the nearest EIA-860M planned / under-construction generator (EIA-860M Planned tab).
fields.interpretation_hints: Gross nameplate (AC basis; solar reported AC, not the larger DC rating), preliminary and revised monthly — not net summer capacity and not firm deliverable MW. Sizes the nearby-buildout signal (a 500 MW unit is a very different signal from a 5 MW unit); pair with nearest_proposed_generator_distance_m and _status. A proposed generator is not load headroom for your site and does not imply you can interconnect there.
fields.name: nearest_proposed_generator_capacity_mw
fields.null_meaning: No EIA-860M planned generator within 100 km, the nearest one reports no nameplate capacity, or the index is not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Development status of the nearest EIA-860M planned generator, decoded from the EIA status code (EIA-860M Planned tab).
fields.interpretation_hints: Imminence lifecycle P->L->T->U->V->TS - Planned, approvals pending, approvals received, under construction <=50%, >50%, complete-not-in-service. V / TS mean imminent new injection and active grid work nearby; P / L are soft or speculative. Planned is NOT a commitment and this is a monthly snapshot, not a forecast — projects get canceled or postponed and a unit can vanish next vintage. Does not tell your own interconnection outcome (a nearby unit can ADD or CONSUME headroom — verify via a utility study).
fields.name: nearest_proposed_generator_status
fields.null_meaning: No EIA-860M planned generator within 100 km, the nearest one reports no status, or the index is not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest open restaurant — any cuisine, incl. fast food, pizza, diner, steakhouse, food court (Overture places; confidence >= 0.5, US only).
fields.interpretation_hints: Everyday-amenity / dining-access proxy for workforce logistics and residential-context screening; catches all cuisine restaurants (incl. pizza, steakhouse) plus fast-food, diner, and food-court venues via the Overture taxonomy (cafes / coffee shops are the separate `cafe` concept).
fields.name: nearest_restaurant_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No open restaurant with Overture confidence >= 0.5 within 50 km of the point.

fields.description: Name of the nearest open restaurant (Overture places).
fields.interpretation_hints: Secondary to the distance field; POI names in conflated data can lag renames/closures — provenance notes carry the record's own Overture conflation confidence.
fields.name: nearest_restaurant_name
fields.null_meaning: No open restaurant within 50 km, or the nearest record has no primary name.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest open cafe / coffee shop, incl. tea room and coffee roastery (Overture places; confidence >= 0.5, US only).
fields.interpretation_hints: Everyday-amenity / coffee-shop access proxy; OR-matches the `cafe`, `coffee_shop`, and `tea_room` taxonomy branches (they are siblings under different parents — coffee roasteries fold in under coffee_shop).
fields.name: nearest_cafe_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No open cafe / coffee shop with Overture confidence >= 0.5 within 50 km of the point.

fields.description: Name of the nearest open cafe / coffee shop (Overture places).
fields.interpretation_hints: Secondary to the distance field; provenance notes carry the record's Overture conflation confidence.
fields.name: nearest_cafe_name
fields.null_meaning: No open cafe / coffee shop within 50 km, or the nearest record has no primary name.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest open bar / pub, incl. brewery, wine / sports / cocktail bar, lounge, nightlife venue (Overture places; confidence >= 0.5, US only).
fields.interpretation_hints: Nightlife / entertainment access proxy for residential-context and mixed-use screening; OR-matches `bar` (incl. its pub, wine / sports / cocktail bar leaves), `brewery`, and `lounge` via the Overture taxonomy (salad/tapas bars stay on the food / casual-eatery path, not here).
fields.name: nearest_bar_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No open bar / pub with Overture confidence >= 0.5 within 50 km of the point.

fields.description: Name of the nearest open bar / pub (Overture places).
fields.interpretation_hints: Secondary to the distance field; provenance notes carry the record's Overture conflation confidence.
fields.name: nearest_bar_name
fields.null_meaning: No open bar / pub within 50 km, or the nearest record has no primary name.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest open gas / fueling station, incl. truck stop and fuel dock (Overture places; confidence >= 0.5, US only).
fields.interpretation_hints: Fuel / refueling access proxy for logistics and site accessibility; EV charging stations are a SEPARATE Overture taxonomy token and are NOT counted here (honest boundary).
fields.name: nearest_gas_station_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No open gas station with Overture confidence >= 0.5 within 50 km of the point.

fields.description: Name of the nearest open gas station (Overture places).
fields.interpretation_hints: Secondary to the distance field; provenance notes carry the record's Overture conflation confidence.
fields.name: nearest_gas_station_name
fields.null_meaning: No open gas station within 50 km, or the nearest record has no primary name.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest open pharmacy / drugstore (Overture places; confidence >= 0.5, US only).
fields.interpretation_hints: Healthcare / everyday-retail access proxy; OR-matches the pharmacy and drugstore taxonomy siblings (chains like CVS/Walgreens tag either); pharmaceutical wholesalers/schools excluded.
fields.name: nearest_pharmacy_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No open pharmacy / drugstore with Overture confidence >= 0.5 within 50 km of the point.

fields.description: Name of the nearest open pharmacy / drugstore (Overture places).
fields.interpretation_hints: Secondary to the distance field; provenance notes carry the record's Overture conflation confidence.
fields.name: nearest_pharmacy_name
fields.null_meaning: No open pharmacy / drugstore within 50 km, or the nearest record has no primary name.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest open bank or credit union (Overture places; confidence >= 0.5, US only).
fields.interpretation_hints: Financial-services access proxy; keys on the Overture `bank_or_credit_union` taxonomy node (banks + credit-union leaves) — there is no bare `bank` token. Standalone ATMs and financial advising are excluded.
fields.name: nearest_bank_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No open bank or credit union with Overture confidence >= 0.5 within 50 km of the point.

fields.description: Name of the nearest open bank or credit union (Overture places).
fields.interpretation_hints: Secondary to the distance field; provenance notes carry the record's Overture conflation confidence.
fields.name: nearest_bank_name
fields.null_meaning: No open bank or credit union within 50 km, or the nearest record has no primary name.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest open shopping center, mall, department store, or outlet store (Overture places; confidence >= 0.5, US only).
fields.interpretation_hints: Retail-hub access proxy for residential-context and commercial siting; OR-matches `shopping_mall`, `department_store`, and `outlet_store` (there is no `shopping_center` token) — the broad `retail` / `shopping` buckets are deliberately excluded (too broad to be a signal).
fields.name: nearest_shopping_center_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No open shopping center, mall, department store, or outlet store with Overture confidence >= 0.5 within 50 km of the point.

fields.description: Name of the nearest open shopping center, mall, department store, or outlet store (Overture places).
fields.interpretation_hints: Secondary to the distance field; provenance notes carry the record's Overture conflation confidence.
fields.name: nearest_shopping_center_name
fields.null_meaning: No open shopping center, mall, department store, or outlet store within 50 km, or the nearest record has no primary name.

fields.description: True if the queried point falls inside an EPA Sewersheds v1.1 service-area polygon — the modeled/documented catchment area whose wastewater flows to one specific POTW (sewage treatment plant).
fields.interpretation_hints: True means the point falls inside an EPA Sewersheds catchment — its wastewater is MODELED or documented to flow to one POTW; False means no sewershed covers it, which across rural America is usually septic reality, NOT a data gap. But the dataset has real coverage holes even in developed areas (e.g. Tega Cay SC reads False despite a live municipal gravity-sewer system), so a False in a developed/incorporated area warrants a nearest_sewer_service_area_distance_m + local-utility cross-check before being read as unsewered. This is not a connection determination: no active sewer tap is confirmed, it is not a will-serve letter (only the utility can commit to a specific parcel), and the polygon may lead or lag pipe-in-ground (planned-expansion, annexed-but-unbuilt, or never-trimmed decommissioned areas). Always co-read sewer_service_area_provenance before trusting it — 81% of polygons are ml_modeled with statistical edges. Pair with sewer_service_area_provider (the POTW) and, when False, with nearest_sewer_service_area_distance_m.
fields.name: within_sewer_service_area

fields.description: CWNS-reported facility (POTW/endpoint) name of the sewershed containing the queried point.
fields.interpretation_hints: The CWNS-reported POTW/endpoint name for the sewershed CONTAINING the point — populated only when within_sewer_service_area is True, never as a "nearest" fallback; null otherwise. Passed through as-is and sometimes consultant/engineering shorthand (e.g. "Chicken Creek (The Manor)"), so treat it as a label, not the legal utility-of-record or customer-facing brand. It is still not a connection determination — the named plant is the modeled discharge endpoint, not proof this parcel is served. Read alongside sewer_service_area_provenance to know whether the boundary is utility_sourced or ml_modeled.
fields.name: sewer_service_area_provider
fields.null_meaning: within_sewer_service_area is False, or the containing record is one of the 2 known composite multi-facility merged rows whose FACILITY_NAME is blank upstream.

fields.description: How the containing sewershed boundary was obtained — utility_sourced (state agency/utility/public GIS) or ml_modeled (EPA hexagon-classifier estimate).
fields.interpretation_hints: How the containing sewershed boundary was obtained: utility_sourced = published by a state/utility/public-GIS source (high evidentiary weight); ml_modeled = an EPA hexagon-classifier estimate (~0.11 km² cells) — 81% of all polygons — whose edge is a statistical guess and never equal in precision to a sourced boundary. NEVER infer this from geography: a well-known utility or a best-sourced state does not imply utility_sourced (downtown Charlotte's Irwin Creek WWTP, in top-sourced NC, is itself modeled), and a state's sourced share is not a per-point guarantee. Gate every confident claim about within_sewer_service_area / sewer_service_area_provider on this field.
fields.name: sewer_service_area_provenance
fields.null_meaning: within_sewer_service_area is False.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest EPA Sewersheds polygon edge; 0.0 when the point is already within one; null beyond the 50 km search cap.
fields.interpretation_hints: Straight-line geodesic distance to the nearest sewershed EDGE: 0.0 when the point is already inside one (i.e. within_sewer_service_area is True), otherwise true edge distance up to 50,000 m; null beyond that means "no sewer service area found within 50 km" — not zero, not unknown. It is a screening proxy only — NOT pipe-route distance, NOT a main-extension cost estimate, NOT a lift-station feasibility signal. Independent of the provider/provenance fields (it populates even outside any sewershed); combine with parcel_zoning and public_water_system_population_served to reason about septic-vs-sewer context.
fields.name: nearest_sewer_service_area_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No sewershed polygon edge falls within the 50 km search cap (a deep-rural / backcountry coordinate).

fields.description: Total resident population of the containing county (Census PEP Vintage 2025 POPESTIMATE2025), keyed by county FIPS.
fields.interpretation_hints: Census PEP **estimate** (Vintage 2025 POPESTIMATE), NOT a decennial census count. County total. Pairs with `county_population_growth_1yr_pct`. Honesty; an inter-censal model estimate revised every vintage, do not treat as an exact enumeration.
fields.name: county_population
fields.null_meaning: County not present in the PEP table, or the dataset is not bootstrapped.

fields.description: One-year county population change (2025 vs 2024 POPESTIMATE, Census PEP Vintage 2025), as a percentage.
fields.interpretation_hints: 1-yr county population change, **computed within a single vintage** (2025 vs 2024 POPESTIMATE). >=1% is a common "growing county" screen threshold. Honesty; never compare across vintages (PEP re-estimates the whole back-series each release), negative = shrinking county.
fields.name: county_population_growth_1yr_pct
fields.null_meaning: County missing from one of the two years, or the dataset is not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Net domestic migration for the containing county (Census PEP Vintage 2025 DOMESTICMIG2025), a component of population change.
fields.interpretation_hints: Net **domestic** migrants (in-out, Vintage 2025 DOMESTICMIG), a component of population change. Excludes international migration and natural change. Honesty; legitimately negative for out-migrating counties, estimate, not a survey count.
fields.name: county_net_domestic_migration
fields.null_meaning: County not present in the PEP table, or the dataset is not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Total residential housing units authorized by building permits in the containing county, latest full year (Census BPS, sum of 1-unit + 2-unit + 3-4 unit + 5+ unit Units).
fields.interpretation_hints: Total residential housing UNITS authorized by building permits, latest full year (2025), from Census BPS. A demand/pipeline signal. Honesty; permits ISSUED != starts != completions, ~44% of counties include **imputed** permits for non-reporting places, annual vintage revised as late reports arrive.
fields.name: county_building_permits_total_annual
fields.null_meaning: County not present in the BPS annual file, or the dataset is not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Single-family (1-unit) housing units authorized by building permits in the containing county, latest full year (Census BPS 1-unit Units).
fields.interpretation_hints: Single-family (1-unit) housing units authorized, latest year (2025), Census BPS. Sibling of `county_building_permits_total_annual` (the multifamily share is total-SF). Honesty; same permits-issued + imputation caveats.
fields.name: county_building_permits_sf_annual
fields.null_meaning: County not present in the BPS annual file, or the dataset is not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Year-over-year percent change in total permitted housing units for the containing county (latest year vs prior year, Census BPS).
fields.interpretation_hints: Year-over-year % change in total permitted units (2025 vs 2024), Census BPS. Momentum signal. Honesty; small-count counties swing hard, both years subject to vintage revision.
fields.name: county_building_permits_yoy_pct
fields.null_meaning: County missing from one of the two years (or a prior total of 0), or the dataset is not bootstrapped.

fields.description: FHFA House Price Index annual percent change for the containing county, latest year (developmental all-transactions county index; the native "Annual Change (%)" column, served verbatim).
fields.interpretation_hints: FHFA House Price Index annual **% change**, latest year (2023), all-transactions county **developmental** index. Honesty; NOT a price or valuation ($), a developmental/experimental series, **low-transaction counties are suppressed -> null (never interpolated)**.
fields.name: county_hpi_yoy_pct
fields.null_meaning: County suppressed for the latest year (low-transaction / small sample), absent from the developmental county set, or the dataset is not bootstrapped.

fields.description: BLS QCEW annual-average covered employment (all ownerships, all industries) for the containing county, latest year.
fields.interpretation_hints: BLS QCEW annual-average **covered** employment (place-of-work), latest year (2025). Honesty; covered (UI) employment excludes self-employed, most agriculture, and military - it is NOT the total labor force.
fields.name: county_employment_total
fields.null_meaning: County not present in the QCEW file (or suppressed on the total row), or the dataset is not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Year-over-year percent change in annual-average covered employment for the containing county (latest year vs prior year, BLS QCEW).
fields.interpretation_hints: Year-over-year % change in covered employment (2025 vs 2024), BLS QCEW. Honesty; covered-employment scope caveat as above, reference is annual average.
fields.name: county_employment_yoy_pct
fields.null_meaning: County missing from one of the two years (or a prior total of 0), or the dataset is not bootstrapped.

fields.description: ACS 5-year pooled median household income (table B19013 estimate) for the containing county, in USD.
fields.interpretation_hints: ACS **2019-2023 5-year pooled** median household income (USD), table B19013. Honesty; a smoothed 5-yr estimate with a margin of error, NOT a point-in-time count, the -666666666 jam value is served as null.
fields.name: county_median_household_income
fields.null_meaning: County suppressed (jam value -666666666), absent from the table, or the dataset is not bootstrapped.

fields.description: Residents aged 16+ in the civilian labor force in this census tract (ACS 5-year B23025, 2020 tract geography).
fields.interpretation_hints: ACS **2019-2023 5-year pooled** civilian labor force count (table B23025_003E), 2020-vintage Census tract. Honesty; a smoothed 5-yr estimate with a margin of error, NOT a point-in-time count. Residence-based (where people live), not jobs-based (where people work) — pairs with `tract_population` for a labor-force-participation read of the tract.
fields.name: tract_civilian_labor_force
fields.null_meaning: value not published for this tract or asset not yet ingested.

fields.description: Total population of this census tract (2020 population-weighted centroid file, CenPop2020).
fields.interpretation_hints: 2020 Census population-weighted tract centroid file (CenPop2020) population count — a decennial-census-based figure, distinct from the ACS 5-yr estimate basis of `tract_civilian_labor_force`.
fields.name: tract_population
fields.null_meaning: value not published for this tract or asset not yet ingested.

fields.description: True if the queried point falls inside a mapped EPA Community Water System (CWS) service-area boundary — the area a public water system reports serving. Sourced from EPA PWS Service Areas V3.0 (March 2026).
fields.interpretation_hints: True means the point is inside a MAPPED EPA CWS service-area boundary — a strong sign municipal water service exists there; it is NOT a will-serve commitment (capacity/annexation are utility decisions). Roughly 43% of EPA polygons are ML-modeled rather than utility-submitted — read `water_service_area_provenance` to know which, and never assume a large or well-known utility is authoritatively mapped. False can mean unserved (well/self-supply territory), or one of the ~5,000 community water systems EPA has not yet mapped (its own documented coverage gap, published as Missing_CWS_V_3_0.csv) — use `nearest_water_service_area_distance_m` to tell 'nowhere near service' from 'just outside a boundary'. VINTAGE NOTE (August 2026): this field moved from the V1.2 (February 2025) edition to V3.0 (March 2026). That edition change flips roughly 702 systems from True to False — SDWIS reclassified them as non-community systems or EPA removed them as inactive/wholesaler — and adds roughly 939 newly-mapped systems, so an answer here can legitimately differ from one taken before August 2026. Read with `water_system_name`, `public_water_system_population_served`, and `within_sewer_service_area`.
fields.name: within_water_service_area

fields.description: Name of the EPA community water system whose mapped service-area polygon contains the point (the most-specific polygon when service areas overlap).
fields.interpretation_hints: Name of the community water system whose mapped service area contains the point (most-specific polygon when areas overlap — typically the retail provider). This is who to contact for a will-serve letter. Complements `nearest_public_water_system_name` (SDWIS admin nearest, which can differ). The boundary that produced this name may be ML-modeled — check `water_service_area_provenance`.
fields.name: water_system_name
fields.null_meaning: point is outside every mapped CWS service area, the containing system's name cell is blank in source, or the local CWS index is unreadable.

fields.description: Straight-line distance to the nearest active RCRA-permitted hazardous-waste Treatment, Storage and Disposal (TSD) facility within an 8 km screening band (EPA Facility Registry Service).
fields.interpretation_hints: Distance to the nearest **active** RCRA-permitted hazardous-waste Treatment, Storage and Disposal facility (EPA FRS RCRAInfo TSD interest layer, ~2,000 nationally). A TSD facility is a **permitted waste-management operation, not evidence of contamination** — it is a land-use/neighbour and community-opposition signal, and a due-diligence prompt, not a contamination measurement. Excludes hazardous-waste *generators* (every hospital and factory notifies as one), transporters, and closed/former TSD facilities. FRS positions are largely address-matched, so treat distance as a screening-scale figure, not a sub-100 m measurement. Read with `nearest_superfund_distance_m` and `nearest_brownfield_distance_m`.
fields.name: nearest_rcra_tsd_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No RCRA TSD facility within 8 km, or the local index is unavailable (bootstrap-pending / corrupt asset).

fields.description: Count of active RCRA-permitted hazardous-waste Treatment, Storage and Disposal (TSD) facilities within 8 km of the point.
fields.interpretation_hints: Exact count of active RCRA TSD facilities within 8 km — a density signal for industrial waste-management corridors. **Counts are per-program and overlap by design:** one physical site can be registered in SEMS *and* ACRES *and* RCRA TSD, so the three counts must not be summed. Zero means none within the band, not none in the area; most non-industrial coordinates return 0. Read with `superfund_sites_within_radius_count` and `brownfields_within_radius_count`.
fields.name: rcra_tsd_facilities_within_radius_count
fields.null_meaning: The local index is unavailable (bootstrap-pending / corrupt asset); a successful empty radius returns 0.

fields.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest wastewater treatment plant in EPA's Clean Watersheds Needs Survey 2022; null beyond the 50 km screening band.
fields.interpretation_hints: Geodesic distance to the nearest wastewater treatment plant in EPA's Clean Watersheds Needs Survey 2022 (17,687 plants nationally), searched within a 50 km screening band. The nearest plant is NOT necessarily the plant that would serve this location — a gravity sewer basin can route a site to a farther plant, and a nearby plant may have no collection main on the parcel. Read with sewer_service_area_provider, which names the plant whose modeled catchment actually contains the point, and with nearest_sewer_service_area_distance_m, which uses the same 50 km cap. CWNS publishes no positional-accuracy metadata, so the coordinate locates a survey record for a plant, not an outfall, headworks or property boundary — treat this as a screening-scale figure, not a sub-100 m measurement. CWNS 2022 is a SURVEY EDITION (data as of January 2022, published April 2024; EPA states a nominally four-year cadence but the previous edition was 2012), so a plant built or retired since is absent.
fields.name: nearest_wastewater_plant_distance_m
fields.null_meaning: No CWNS 2022 wastewater treatment plant within 50 km (a semantic absence), or the local index is unavailable (bootstrap-pending / corrupt asset).

fields.description: CWNS-reported facility name of the nearest wastewater treatment plant, passed through verbatim.
fields.interpretation_hints: The plant's name as reported to CWNS, passed through verbatim — sometimes local or engineering shorthand, and occasionally carrying upstream whitespace quirks — so treat it as a label, not the legal utility of record. It is the lead for due diligence: look the plant up (its NPDES permit and discharge-monitoring reports are public in EPA ECHO) before characterizing it.
